articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Method for Detecting Surface Defects in Air Filters
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: To prevent defective air filters from reaching the market, it is essential to conduct defect inspections on their appearance. This paper proposes a deep learning-based method for detecting surface defects in air filters. We utilize a linear array camera to capture images of air filters, constructing a dataset and designing a defect detection algorithm. For the outer metal mesh and inner filter material, we propose a multistage detection approach: (1) segmenting the inner and outer structures using a style transfer model; (2) performing defect-free reconstruction of the metal mesh and localizing defects through residual analysis; (3) classifying and pixel-level localizing defects in the connected regions of the filter material. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively achieves pixel-level defect localization even in the presence of an imbalance between defective and non-defective data.

articleTitle: High-Capacity Reversible Data Hiding Algorithm for Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Medical images have problems such as low information embedding capacity, high difficulty, and obvious distortion. To solve the above problems, a high-capacity reversible data hiding algorithm based on medical images is proposed. Firstly, the image is preprocessed against overflow by using Run-Length Encoding compression, and then use the designed PPC-VO predictor to predict pixels. Based on the prediction error, perform four rounds of information embedding. The experimental results show that after image preprocessing, the maximum embedding capacity of the algorithm is increased by over 80000 bits compared to the comparative literature.

articleTitle: Fine-Grained Passive Operating System Identification Based on Network Traffic Sequences
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: For the problem of passive operating system fingerprinting in encrypted traffic, most existing methods identify operating systems by extracting TCP/IP protocol features and flow statistics from individual session flows and applying machine learning techniques. While these approaches perform well in identifying OS types, their accuracy in distinguishing OS versions remains limited due to the similarity in TCP/IP stack implementations across different versions of the same OS. To address this issue, this paper proposes a traffic-sequence-based method for OS and version identification. First, multiple consecutive session flows from a host are captured and grouped into a sequence. TCP/IP protocol features and flow statistics are then extracted for each session. By constructing a bidirectional GRU(Gated Recurrent Unit)model, dependencies between session flow sequences are incorporated on top of the existing features. Compared with current methods, this approach achieves high identification accuracy and performs well across different OS versions.

articleTitle: CPA-UNet: nnUNet-Based Local Pyramid Aggregation Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose CPA-UNet, a segmentation model for diabetic foot ulcers based on the nnUNet architecture. Initially, the model employs a ResNet-D module for diabetic foot ulcer images to establish residual connections, thereby reducing information loss in skip connections. Subsequently, a Local Pyramid Attention (LPA) module is utilized to aggregate both local and global attention, enhancing the focus on the lesion area, in addition, the accuracy is improved by incorporating the ConvNeXt convolution module. The results of our experiments using the DFUC2022 dataset indicate that, compared to the classic models Mask R-CNN, FCN, U-Net, DeeplabV3, and nnUNet, for diabetic foot ulcers, the proposed model achieved segmentation accuracy improvements of 6.5%, 5.7%, 7.3%, 3.7%, and 1.9%, respectively.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control of Starting Point Based on System Data Degradation SCR
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: In this paper, the prediction starting point detection algorithm based on the real-time change trend of the state is used to divide and control the health status of the system data, and the adaptive control of the starting point threshold of life decay is carried out by analyzing the change trend of the SCR (State Change Rate) of the system data degradation process, so as to improve the accuracy of the prediction starting point detection. The time-domain and frequency-domain features of the processed signal are extracted, and the evaluation index is constructed through the monotonicity and predictiveness of the features, and the suitable features are selected as the basis for the remaining life prediction of the system data. High-dimensional feature processing and screening of system data. In this paper, through a large number of simulation experiments, the monotonicity law of system data features and the trend law of system data characteristics are obtained. The validity of weighting the monotonicity and trend of the system data features is verified, and the weight of monotonicity is 0.6 and the weight of trend is 0.4 in the verification system, and the calculation results of the evaluation index of each feature of the system data are obtained. It is concluded that the peak, variance, root square amplitude, root mean square value, kurtosis value and peak factor are used as inputs for the remaining life prediction for the degradation of the system data.

articleTitle: MFB: A 3D point cloud segmentation model based on Mamba
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Mamba-based approaches have performed extremely well in point cloud segmentation tasks, but still have limitations regarding computational efficiency and global context understanding. To solve this problem, we propose MFB (Mamba Fusion Block), which composes of two parts, one is similar to the previous Mamba block, and the other is our integrated linear attention and Mamba-like Linear Attention (MLLA). Among them, Linear Attention implements a mechanism based on rotational position encoding for processing point cloud features, which can better obtain the feature details from point cloud data and improve the model’s performance for point cloud segmentation. MLLA, while maintaining the original structure of Mamba Block, further enhances the model’s capacity to learn features at multiple scales. The experimental outcomes indicate that Our proposed approach outshines the existing Mamba-based methods on the ShapeNetPart dataset.

articleTitle: Research On YOLOv8 UAV Ground Target Detection Based On RK3588
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: In order to realize the deployment of object detection on edge computing devices more efficiently and quickly, and improve the ability of UAV to detect ground targets, this paper selects the Rockchip RK3588 chip to compile and quantitatively deploy the YOLOv8 object detection algorithm model, and proposes a multi-threaded resource interlock design through airborne computing inference optimization, so as to realize the convolutional neural network to improve the ability of UAV ground target detection. In terms of RK3588 inference speed analysis, after the optimization and improvement of multi-threaded optimization processing, when the number of threads is 3, the fps has basically reached about 100, and a method of knowledge distillation applied to the lightweight processing of the object detection model is proposed to quantify the original FP32 model. The number of detection targets and the detection confidence information of the two are counted, which shows that the detection accuracy and detection confidence of INT8 are basically unchanged.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection with CNNs: A Comparative Study of Deep Learning and Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: The exponential increase in internet usage has led to a surge in cyber threats and network attacks, making them critical challenges in today’s digital landscape. Leveraging machine learning techniques has proven effective in detecting and addressing network intrusions. This study focuses on the application of deep learning, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), for improving the detection and classification of intrusions within the NSL-KDD and UNSW-NB15 datasets. The performance of CNN models is compared against several widely-used machine learning algorithms, including Gaussian Naïve Bayes, Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors, Support Vector Machines (SVM), AdaBoost, XGBoost, CatBoost, and LightGBM. The experimental analysis reveals that CNN-based approaches consistently surpass traditional classifiers, offering enhanced accuracy and robustness in identifying cyber threats.

articleTitle: Application of Transmission Line Scene Model Construction Method in Electric Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: In view of the increasing demand of 3D model construction in digital twin application scenarios, there are already reverse manual modeling of laser point cloud of equipment department and GIM modeling of infrastructure department. Refined 3D modeling techniques such as transmission channels are relatively mature, but there are still many problems in the application. For the increasing construction requirements of 3D models for digital twin application scenarios, through the accumulation of laser point cloud reverse modeling, infrastructure GIM model and other transmission and transformation model libraries, data drive, CAD drawing image recognition, laser point cloud registration and other technologies, the technical breakthrough of parameterized model of digital twin 3D scene of power transmission and transformation is realized. This scheme meets the application requirements of differentiated 3D model accuracy, greatly saves the modeling labor cost, and improves the modeling efficiency.

articleTitle: Source signal recovery method based on population entropy quantum Remora fish optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Within the domain of underdetermined blind source separation, the efficacy of existing source signal recovery methodologies is critically contingent upon the precision of initial signal estimation. Suboptimal performance frequently arises from this dependency, stemming from the insufficiency of initial parameter configurations. This study introduces an innovative and efficacious technique for the recovery of source signals, specifically designed to overcome the encountered engineering obstacles. Thus, we introduce an innovative Remora fish optimization algorithm with population entropy and quantum-behaved characteristics, designed to enhance the optimization of the objective function through the integration of a dynamic penalty function. The preliminary estimated signal configuration for source recovery, utilizing the radial basis function network, is transformed into an initial candidate solution within the population. The solution characterized by optimal parameters, derived from the application of the population entropy quantum Remora fish optimization algorithm, is employed as an updated initial estimation signal to facilitate effective source recovery. The extensive simulation outcomes indicate that the method proposed in this study possesses enhanced robustness and broader applicability, thereby rendering the initial parameter configuration more rational.

articleTitle: Audio detection based on segmented spectrograms
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Detecting depression at an early stage is very important in treating it. In this paper, we propose a model for detecting depression using deep learning for detecting depression using patients' speech features. The model is built by establishing the spectral features of the audio using a Resnet34 network that incorporates the SKNet attention mechanism. This paper is assessed using the DAIC-WOZ dataset provided by the AVEC 2016 Depression Analysis Challenge. The experimental findings demonstrate that the model proposed in this paper surpasses the baseline model and achieves superior results in unimodal features.

articleTitle: FPGA-based Moving Object Detection Leveraging Frame Difference and Morphological Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Moving object detection plays a significant role in video surveillance. However, existing moving object detection methods often rely on software implementations, which means low real-time performance and high power consumption. This paper's core detection algorithm employs a frame difference method that is enhanced by morphological filtering. Additionally, we propose an architecture that integrates FPGA(Field Programmable Gate Array) and ARM(Advanced RISC Machine), fully leveraging the parallel computing advantages of FPGA and the high processing efficiency of ARM. The system utilizes a ZYNQ7000 SoC, coupled with an OV7725 camera for image capture and DDR3 SDRAM for data caching, to address the challenges of high-speed data processing and low power consumption. Experimental results show that the system meets the requirements for high real-time performance and low power consumption with a frame rate of 85.9375 frames per second and a total power consumption of 1.101 W.

articleTitle: Re-Raft: An Improved Blockchain Consensus Algorithm with Enhanced Byzantine Resistance and Crash Tolerance
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: The traditional Raft consensus algorithm is widely used in private chains due to its crash-tolerant feature, but it cannot solve many problems caused by the malicious behaviour of Byzantine nodes. Based on an in-depth analysis of existing research results, this paper proposes a consensus algorithm based on the Raft algorithm with enhanced Byzantine resistance and crash tolerance: Re-Raft (Reliability-Raft), in order to solve the core problems of Byzantine nodes identity forgery and illegal replacement of leaders. A fault heartbeat logging mechanism is introduced to prevent Byzantine nodes from obtaining the majority of votes by broadcasting fault heartbeat logs; and a node reliability assessment algorithm is proposed to accurately assess the reliability of nodes by combining the continuity penalty weights and the time decay factor to reduce communication redundancy triggered by frequent node failures. The experimental results show that compared with the native Raft, the Re-Raft algorithm achieves a significant improvement in Byzantine fault-tolerance capability.

articleTitle: Mobile Robot Path Planning Based On Improved DDQN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: A deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithm integrating Prioritized Experience Replay (PER) & Double Deep Q-Network (DDQN) is proposed. It boosts training data sample quality via adjusting experience replay priority, brings in N-step bootstrap for more accurate Q-value estimation, & combines with dual Q-learning to solve traditional Q-learning's over-estimation. Compared with traditional DDQN & DDQN with PER, the DDQN-NstepPER algorithm is more stable in training. The Webots simulation experiment with Pioneer 3-DX robot shows it can achieve mobile robot path planning in complex environment with good effect.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Identity-Based Encryption Scheme Based on RLWE
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Attribute-based encryption (ABE), as an extension of identity-based encryption (IBE), can provide fine-grained access control and is very useful in many practical application scenarios. Among them, fuzzy IBE, as a variant of ABE, provides users with a threshold access structure. The existing ABE schemes have increasing computational and storage overheads as the number of attributes grows, making them inefficient. This paper mainly uses the RLWE hard problem based on lattices to construct the ABE scheme, and the use of polynomial rings can significantly reduce the computational and storage overheads of existing schemes. Finally, we prove that our scheme satisfies chosen-plaintext security in the standard model. The performance analysis shows that our scheme has good computational and storage overheads.

articleTitle: A novel clustering method for ship trajectory prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Accurate ship trajectory prediction is crucial for ensuring maritime shipping safety. Current trajectory prediction methods primarily focus on analyzing the spatial interactions between ships, often overlooking the critical role of potential destinations. Furthermore, existing methods predominantly focus on straight trajectory prediction, resulting in suboptimal performance when predicting curved trajectories, which are prevalent in real-world scenarios. To address these issues, we propose a novel method based on bidirectional LSTM and destination/source clustering, referred to as GRU-Bi-LSTM-GRU (GBG). Our approach effectively captures various ship movement patterns by clustering destination/source clustering. Then, a bidirectional LSTM classification network is used to determine the ship’s destination. Finally, the trajectory output network generates a trajectory towards the predicted destination. We evaluated the GBG model on three public datasets, and the experimental results demonstrate that it surpasses existing methods in both multi-curved and multi-straight trajectory datasets, achieving higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Home Medicine Box AI System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of daily medication and health and safety care for the elderly, this paper uses the Internet of Things technology to design and implement a home medicine box AI system based on Raspberry PI, which is composed of three parts: medicine cabinet management system, electronic bracelet system and wechat mini program. The medicine cabinet control system utilizes Raspberry PI 4b as the central processing unit, incorporating a timing sensor, voice sensor, and temperature and humidity sensor. The electronic bracelet's control system utilizes STM32 as the primary control board, while the development board incorporates a dual-mode positioning sensor, cardiovascular oxygen sensor, voice module, network module, and six-axis acceleration sensor interconnected with dupont wires. The electronic bracelet control system facilitates functions such as positioning, heart rate acquisition, voice broadcasting, wireless communication, and attitude acquisition. The mobile WeChat mini program enables remote monitoring and control of medicine cabinets and the health status of elderly individuals, providing functions such as temperature and humidity monitoring, timed voice medication reminders, heart rate monitoring, posture monitoring, and positioning. The test results demonstrate the system's stability and reliability, thereby providing robust technical support for home monitoring.

articleTitle: HQFace: Towards Real-World Blind Face Restoration with Hierarchical Vector Quantization
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: The goal of blind face restoration (BFR) is to reconstruct detailed and lifelike facial images from inputs that have undergone unknown forms of degradation. While current methods utilize priors to refine details and have achieved notable advancements, they often fail to fully utilize the intricate information within facial features and their interactions with these priors, leading to suboptimal results. Moreover, the discrepancy between synthetic simulations and actual-world conditions is frequently overlooked, compromising robustness and real-world efficacy. Our study introduces HQFace, a novel approach employing Hierarchical Vector Quantization (HVQ) to overcome these shortcomings, enhancing the capture and manipulation of contextual data with priors and integrating gated cross attention (GCA) for higher-quality, more realistic images. HQFace advances beyond traditional methods by using HVQ across multi-scale features for a detailed examination of spatial dynamics between degraded data and high-quality priors, ensuring restorations of greater realism and fidelity. Furthermore, our development of GCA targets superior facial components alignment with restoration goals, and an expanded degradation model encompasses a broader range of realistic scenarios, enhancing robustness and applicability. Extensive testing confirms HQFace’s superior performance over leading algorithms on the CelebA-HQ.

articleTitle: Wrapper-based feature selection for general data set: the quantum sand cat swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: The existing wrapper feature selection methods have problems such as the difficulty of balancing a relatively high classification accuracy rate with a low feature selection rate, and there are problems such as long time consumption. In response to these issues, this paper combines quantum computing theory and sand cat swarm optimization to design quantum sand cat swarm optimization and combined with K-nearest neighbor method for feature selection. The optimal solution of quantum sand cat swarm optimization is set as the selected optimal feature subset. Simulation experiments are executed on 6 UCI data sets to compare with 4 classical swarm intelligence algorithms. The simulation outcomes show that the wrapper feature selection on the ground of quantum sand cat swarm optimization achieves lower feature selection rate , faster time and higher classification accuracy than the comparison method. It is a high precision and practical wrapper feature selection method.

articleTitle: Enhancing Visual P300 Amplitudes Using Continuous Theta Burst Stimulation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: This reseach investigated the effects of different repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) modes on the modulation of the visual P300 component in electroencephalogram (EEG), a critical biomaker of cognitive processes in the brain. Five rTMS modes, including 1Hz rTMS, 10Hz rTMS, continuous theta burst stimulation (cTBS), intermittent TBS (iTBS), and sham stimulation, were applied to 12 healthy participants using a visual oddball paradigm. EEG signals were collected and analyzed to measure P300 amplitudes under four visual stimulus configurations. The results showed that cTBS significantly enhanced P300 amplitudes across all visual configurations, while 1Hz rTMS and iTBS had selective modulatory effects depending on specific stimulus conditions. In contrast, 10Hz rTMS had no significant effect on P300 amplitudes. These findings suggest that cTBS may be particularly effective in enhancing P300-related cognitive processing and hold promise in improving the performance of P300-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs).

articleTitle: Improving Panoptic Segmentation in Occlusion with a Local-aware Decoder
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Panoptic segmentation, a unifying computer vision task combining semantic and instance segmentation, plays a crucial role in autonomous driving and robot navigation applications. With advancements in deep learning technology, particularly the introduction of the Transformer model, panoptic segmentation achieved significant progress. However, existing methods still struggle with performance in occluded and detailed regions. In this network, a local aware decoder has been designed to replace the Transformer decoder, guiding the network to concentrate on local areas. The proposed network improves segmentation accuracy, reduces the model’s size, and lowers computational costs. The experimental results indicate that our proposed method is effective, attaining a competitive PQ score of 63.0 on the Cityscapes dataset.

articleTitle: A Sequence-to-Sequence Based Muti-Semantic Network with Attention for Long-Term Vessel Trajectory Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Forecasting ship trajectories is essential for ensuring the safety and efficiency of maritime operations. The evolution of deep learning has enabled using AIS (Automatic Identification System) data to predict vessel paths effectively. However, current approaches rely solely on a ship's latitude, longitude, and heading, leading to inaccuracies when forecasting diverse ship types. Additionally, a ship's sailing range is influenced by factors like endurance, fuel capacity, tides, and crew routines. To tackle these challenges, we introduce a new Sequence-to-Sequence based long-term vessel trajectory prediction network, named S2S-MSA. This model features a multi-semantic encoder-decoder architecture with an attention mechanism. The encoder translates voyage details into enriched latent vectors to capture navigational characteristics. We also introduce a multi-semantic decoder that considers ship type for trajectory forecasting. To assess S2S-MSA's performance, we use AIS data from ships in the southern Yangtze River estuary and compare it with other models. The outcomes show that S2S-MSA excels in both quantitative and qualitative metrics.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Deep Learning Methods for Age-appropriate Sensitive Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Currently, communication media such as movies have a more mature grading system, but images widely disseminated on social media do not. Additionally, in the new media environment, the dissemination of sensitive images has become more covert and diversified, posing a potential threat to the mental health of adolescents. Therefore, solving the challenge of implementing age-appropriate grading for sensitive images using computer vision technology is crucial. Based on this premise, this paper first constructs an age-appropriate dataset for grading sensitive images targeted at teenagers to provide reference for image dissemination on social media platforms. Then, it evaluates the performance of eight deep learning models including ResNet101, ShuffleNet-v1, Vgg11, Vgg16, DenseNet101, MobileNet-v2, Swin Transformer, and Vision Transformer models in terms of their ability to recognize sensitive images. We finally conduct comprehensive tests on both a 2-category public dataset and a quaternary age-appropriate dataset; experimental results demonstrate that MobileNet-v2 network and Swin Transformer network exhibit superior performance on the two datasets respectively. The research findings presented in this paper serve as an important reference for managing image dissemination and classification on social media.

articleTitle: Research on Kill Chain Resource Allocation Optimization Based on Reinforcement Learning and Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: This paper investigates a resource allocation optimization method based on reinforcement learning and game theory for resource management in kill chain tasks. By constructing a game-theoretic model to analyze the interaction between attackers and defenders and integrating deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms for adaptive strategy optimization, this approach aims to enhance the efficiency of resource allocation for the defender. The proposed method leverages a combination of game theory’s strategic interaction modeling and reinforcement learning’s decision-making capability in uncertain environments. Simulation results demonstrate that the method effectively optimizes resource allocation in dynamic, adversarial scenarios, improving both defense success rate and resource utilization efficiency. Additionally, the performance of the method is compared with traditional heuristic algorithms, showing a clear improvement in terms of adaptability and resource management.

articleTitle: Construction of 1-resilient Boolean functions with good cryptographic properties via genetic tabu search algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: In this paper, through combining the advantages of genetic algorithm and tabu search algorithm, a new algorithm called genetic tabu search (GTS) to obtain even-variable Boolean functions satisfying all the needed criteria: strictly almost optimal (SAO) nonlinearity, 1-resiliency, optimal algebraic degree, low autocorrelation, and optimal (or suboptimal) algebraic immunity is presented. It is shown that the proposed algorithm can achieve a better tradeoff among multiple cryptographic criteria than those of the previous research results.

articleTitle: DynamicKV: Data Storage Strategy Based on Partition Merging of Log-Structured Merge Tree
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: The Log-Structured Merge Tree (LSM tree) is a prevalent data structure in numerous databases and storage systems due to its efficient indexing capabilities for record insertion and deletion. However, the LSM tree records data changes by appending to new data blocks, which means that outdated blocks are not immediately overwritten or purged. This can lead to a proliferation of redundant data across multiple blocks. The present paper introduces a partition-based merge data storage approach to address this issue. This paper proposes a data storage methodology that leverages partition merging. It segments the LSM tree's data storage blocks into several sub-blocks ("Blocks") and employs an index tree to facilitate organized storage. Utilizing a sliding window mechanism to identify which Blocks require merging and matching data to eliminate redundancies, this approach effectively tackles the problem of data redundancy. Our evaluation indicates that implementing the data merging strategy has resulted in a 25% increase in storage space utilization for the LSM tree and has enhanced query performance by 10%.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Detection and Analysis Based On Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: In order to achieve China's "carbon peak", "carbon neutral" strategic development goals, the development and reuse of clean energy is very important, accurate and efficient extraction of wind turbines for wind energy utilization efficiency and environmental protection is of great significance, but the manual visual However, the manual visual interpretation method is too inefficient to meet the demand of large-scale accurate monitoring. Aiming at the variable scale of wind turbines in remote sensing images, a batch of 2m resolution samples are produced to train the model for accurate wind turbine extraction. Based on the deep learning network YOLOv9 (You Only Look Once), the SPD-Conv module is added to enhance the network's ability to detect small targets, and at the same time, adapt to the semantic features of wind turbines in different contexts. Finally, based on the domestic GF-1 satellite images, the extraction of wind turbines in North China is realized. The experimental results show that the extraction accuracy of the network can reach 91.2%.

articleTitle: Potato Disease Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Address the challenges posed by the diverse range of potato fruit defects, which encompass difficulties in detection and limited accuracy, an improved YOLOv8 potato disease detection algorithm is proposed. Firstly, for the lack of spatial information capturing ability of the original YOLOv8 model, the DRB idea is introduced to improve the C2f module, and then the original C2f module is improved by the improved C2f-DRB module. Secondly, for the problem that small targets of potato diseases are not easy to be detected, the CARAFE up-sampling operator is introduced to improve the model's ability of extracting features of the disease, and to enhance the effect of the disease detection. Finally, the original IoU loss function of the model is improved using the Inner IoU loss function, which enhances the generalization ability of the model. Relevant comparison experiments were constructed for ten kinds of diseased potatoes, and the results showed that the improved YOLOv8 algorithm improved 2.4%, 1.7%, and 1.5% in precision, recall, and mAP50, respectively, which proved the proposed algorithm had better performance, and verified the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Fault Diagnosis Method For Marine Engine Using Isolation Forest and Extreme Learning Machine with PADBSCAN
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: In the age of digitalization and automation, research on data-driven marine engine fault diagnosis is ongoing. However, the volume of normal data in real-world environments significantly exceeds that of fault data, and there will be unknown fault modes that are not collected, which leads to incorrect diagnosis. To address the challenge of open-set fault diagnosis for marine engines under conditions of data imbalance, this paper proposes a hierarchical fault diagnosis method, based on Isolation Forest (iForest), Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) and Parameter-Adaptive Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (PADBSCAN), named HFD-IEP. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, AVL BOOST was utilized to simulate a two-stroke marine diesel engine. The simulation results confirm the method's effectiveness.

articleTitle: Binocular Vision Based Pavement Flatness Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Leveling detection belongs to an important part of pavement inspection, and its detection technology has been developing. In this paper, we propose to detect pavement flatness based on binocular vision, and obtain the point cloud data of the pavement through the study of the calibration, correction and matching algorithm of binocular camera. In the feature extraction of the pavement point cloud data, the self-attention mechanism module is introduced to capture the relationship between different points. By calculating the similarity between individual points, the model can focus on those points that are most helpful for feature extraction of the current point during feature extraction. For the collected pavement point cloud data firstly, voxel filtering is utilized for noise reduction and thinning, which preserves the geometric features of the overall point cloud. Then, the RANSAC algorithm is used to fit the point cloud to the plane. The height difference information between the fitted plane and the pavement point cloud is used. This information is used to calculate the pavement flatness. The experimental results of the levelness detection are based on binocular vision. The results are 0.086 and 0.06 higher than the two traditional detection methods. The two traditional methods are the precision level and the bump accumulator. This method reduces manual operation. It improves the working efficiency in the measurement work.

articleTitle: Learning Temporal Consistency Correlation Filter with Gradient Feature for UAV Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel target tracking model that integrates a learning temporal consistency constraint (LTCF) guided by gradient features, seamlessly embedding it within a correlation filter-based tracking framework. This model incorporates the gradient feature of the correlation filter to enhance information extraction and feature representation in the tracking model for small targets. Additionally, the entire model is effectively solved using an alternating optimization method. To assess the performance of the proposed tracking algorithm, we conduct comparative experiments on LTCF and other tracking models using multiple datasets. The experimental results demonstrate that the LTCF model delivers robust tracking performance in complex scenes, ensuring both accuracy and reliability in target tracking.

articleTitle: A Novel Non-Line-of-Sight Imaging Enhancement Method of Time-of-Flight Camera
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: In recent years, Non-Line-of-Sight (NLoS) imaging methods based on Time-of-Flight (ToF) camera are mainly proposed for the point cloud data obtained by the double-scattering light path where the light source and the detector are distributed on opposite sides of the occluder. Meanwhile, the research objects are mostly static targets. In order to further improve the application capability of the ToF camera, the point cloud data of moving personnel acquired by the mainstream triple-scattering light path in the NLoS domain has attracted the attention of this paper. Moreover, a novel NLoS imaging enhancement method is proposed. By utilizing the depth distribution characteristics of point clouds and the principle of echo, the issues such as high noise and poor visual characteristics in NLoS point cloud data are addressed. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Compared to the Natural Image Quality Evaluator (NIQE) value of the raw data, the NIQE value of the enhanced results in this paper decreases nearly three times.

articleTitle: An Image-to-image Target Reconstruction Network for Capacitively Coupled Electrical Resistance Tomography Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: This work develops an image-to-image target reconstruction network for capacitively coupled electrical resistance tomography. The novel target reconstruction network is constructed by two Unets to extract and fuse the multi-frequency features of the coarse images reconstructed by traditional image reconstruction algorithms, and incorporated with transfer learning to improve the generalization ability of the network. Experimental results show that the developed target reconstruction network is effective. The Unet-based image-to-image framework improves the target reconstruction quality with quantitatively higher image score. The introduced transfer learning strategy fills the gap between simulation data and experimental data, and further improves the performance of the network.

Author Keywords: contactless imaging; target reconstruction; multi-frequency image fusion; transfer learning

articleTitle: Hybrid Tensor Networks: The Integration of Quantum and Classical Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Tensor networks can compactly represent high-dimensional data in the form of low-rank tensor decompositions, which helps capture complex structures and correlations within the data. However, their inherently multilinear nature limits their potential as universal approximators. To address this limitation, tensor networks are combined with classical neural network layers, introducing nonlinear elements to enhance the model’s expressive power. The Hybrid Tensor Networks (HTN) system encompasses two prevalent tensor network configurations, Matrix Product States and Tree Tensor Networks, which facilitates the adaptable design of models customized for particular machine learning applications. This framework has been validated on classification and image reconstruction tasks, demonstrating its potential to handle complex data structures and its applicability within the machine learning field. Employing this approach, the goal is to establish a foundation for future research on hybrid quantum-classical models, thereby opening up avenues for the realm of quantum machine learning.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph to Facilitate Cloud Security Compliance with NIST Cybersecurity Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Cybersecurity compliance has become increasingly complex due to evolving threats, overlapping standards, and rapidly changing requirements driven by emerging technologies like artificial intelligence. Organizations face significant challenges in efficiently mapping compliance requirements to specific security controls. This paper addresses this issue within the cloud industry by presenting a systematic approach to deploying a knowledge graph or ontology that maps cloud security controls at the granular implementation level to the NIST Cybersecurity Framework. Unlike previous efforts focused on high-level mappings, this approach enhances compliance efficiency and supports integration with common software languages such as HTTP and Java. The proposed methodology can also be adapted to other compliance standards.

articleTitle: ES-ShuffleNetV2 Model for Maize Disease Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of maize disease recognition and take into account the practical requirements of portable equipment, a novel ES-ShuffleNetV2 maize disease lightweight recognition model was proposed in this paper. The new model is based on the ShuffleNetV2 model, adding the attention module SE after the first layer of convolution to enhance the model's attention to important features. In addition, by replacing the subsampling unit at each stage and the ReLU activation function of the base unit with the ELU function, a relatively small negative gradient inflow is allowed to make the gradient propagation smoother to accelerate the convergence rate of model training. Experimental results showed that the Accuracy of ES-ShuffleNetV2 in maize disease identification reached 99.82%, higher than the basic model's 96.05%, and the computational load remained at a relatively low level. Meanwhile, the Accuracy, F1-Score and other evaluation indexes were superior to other network models involved in the comparison. The effectiveness of the new model in maize disease identification was further verified.

articleTitle: High Definition Flame Image Recognition Technology based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that conventional YOLOv8 model cannot recognize high definition flame images taken by UAV, this paper proposes a high definition flame recognition method based on the improved YOLOv8 model. By introducing GhostNetV2 module into the YOLOv8 backbone network, this method greatly increases the model parameters and improves the feature extraction capability and flame recognition capability of the model while speeding up the fire detection speed. The Efficient Local Attention (ELA) mechanism is added to further enhance the perception of flame characteristics. By introducing the Slicing Aided Hyper Inference(SAHI) Framework , the detection rate of small targets has been significantly improved. Furthermore, we have enhanced SAHI based on this, resulting in a substantial increase in its speed. The test results show that the performance of the improved YOLOv8 intersects with the YOLOv8n model, and the mAP50 and MAP50-95 improve by 4.0% and 6.5% respectively. Compared with SAHI, the improved SAHI speed increases by 151.97% on average, which effectively realizes the balance between model speed and accuracy, and has broad application value in UAV firefighting tasks.

articleTitle: A Novel Design Method of Light-weight Minisocpe without Object Lenses for Calcium Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Single-photon calcium imaging miniscope is a common technique in neuroscience. However, the size and weight of current miniscopes, because of the necessary 0.5mm GRIN lens, is big and heavy, which impacts the behavior of the animals to some extent. This kind of behavior limitation had a strong impaction on the neuronal activities which were recorded by miniscopes. Here, we designed a new optic light path, based on the simplified model of GRIN lens, reduced the size and weight to 2/3 the size and weight compared to the original minisocpes by replacing the 0.5 pitch GRIN lens to 0.25 pitch GRIN lens. At the same time, the resolution and image field diameter recorded by our minisocpe are the same with original minisocpes.

articleTitle: Computational F-waves Extraction from Single-Lead Atrial Fibrillation ECG Based on a Frequency-Modulated Möbius Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a prevalent arrhythmia characterized by the disappearance of P waves and the emergence of F waves in electrocardiogram (ECG) signals. F waves carry vital diagnostic information about AF episodes. This study proposes a computational method for extracting F waves from single-lead AF ECGs using a Frequency-Modulated Möbius (FMM) model. The algorithm decomposes AF signals into FMM-D components by adjusting a decomposition factor D, preserving the QRST wave phase information. These components are reconstructed to form QRST waves, and F waves are isolated through a template cancellation technique. Compared to Average Beat Subtraction (ABS) and Principal Component Analysis (PCA), the proposed method achieves lower normalized mean square error (NMSE), higher signal-to-component ratio (SC), and superior noise robustness. This approach provides a reliable computational framework for biomedical signal analysis and AF diagnosis.

articleTitle: Cloud resource scheduling strategy based on improved particle swarm optimization algorithm for smart city system
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Smart city facilitates people's lives from all aspects, but the complex equipment data analysis and processing, huge data calculation limit the development of smart city system, so reasonable scheduling of cloud computing resources make the smart city system hard to operate smoothly and orderly. To cope with problems above concerned, an novel method combined particle swarm algorithm with improved strategy is applied: First, the weight parameter of the social and cognitive coefficients in the particle swarm algorithm were adjusted to better conform to the optimal solution and avoid getting stuck in local optima; Second, an inertia weight function and an adjustment operator was defined during the search process to optimize position updates, thereby the convergence efficiency was improved and the global optimal solution was conformed; third, the load balance in cloud environments is considered by limiting the load rate of physical machines to place physical resources, then the service quality and user needs are assured. We can see in experiments that the proposed method can effectively integrate into the system, by searching the global optimal solution efficiently and improving the convergence efficiency of traditional particle swarm, the resource utilization and system performance was improved.

articleTitle: Image Recognition Method Based on the Fusion of Multimodal Large Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: With the development of deep learning technology, image recognition has made significant progress in various fields. However, the performance of recognition models is limited by single-modal information, especially in complex scenarios where traditional deep learning methods lack generalization ability. This paper proposes an image recognition method based on multimodal large model fusion (BFMLM), which leverages the correlation between multimodal data to achieve cross-modal feature fusion, improving the accuracy and robustness of the model in target recognition. Experiments show that, compared to traditional deep learning-based single-modal image recognition algorithms, the proposed method performs better on multiple datasets.

articleTitle: The Trustworthiness Measurement Model of Component based on Spherical Fuzzy Sets
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: With the continuous increase of functions of the software system, a highly trustworthy software system can help users solve problems in daily life better. How to evaluate a software system's trustworthiness has become an important problem in software engineering. Based on subjective and objective weights, this paper proposes a method to calculate the trustworthiness of components. Firstly, based on spherical fuzzy sets, expert weights are determined by expert similarity, and the subjective weights of component attributes are obtained by combining expert weights with the evaluation of component attributes by experts. Secondly, the initial variance of component attributes is improved, and the objective weight of component attributes is calculated by using the improved variance method. Furthermore, combining the subjective and objective weights, the component attribute weight distribution method is proposed, and then the component trustworthiness measurement model is established. Finally, the component’s trustworthiness in the cross-border medical management system project is evaluated to show the rationality of the measurement model.

articleTitle: The Defect Detection Algorithm for Sintered NdFeB Based on ADSEAM-YOLO
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: To address the challenges commonly encountered in the detection of sintered NdFeB, such as insufficient speed and accuracy, difficulty in detecting small targets, and noise interference, this paper proposes an innovative and efficient algorithm framework. This framework is based on an Attention-guided Convolutional Neural Network and a Separation and Enhancement Attention Module, referred to as ADSEAM-YOLO. Firstly, to effectively tackle noise interference, an Attention-guided CNN is integrated into the Backbone network. By combining the strengths of both dilated convolution and conventional convolution, this design enhances the network's ability to capture key features while significantly reducing the impact of background noise, thus laying a solid foundation for subsequent accurate detection. Secondly, at the critical feature fusion stage (Neck layer), the SEAM module is introduced. This module fully leverages multi-scale feature information and employs depthwise separable convolution to deeply explore and learn the complex correlations between spatial dimensions and channels. This innovation not only greatly improves the algorithm's ability to detect micro-defects in sintered NdFeB but also ensures the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the detection results. Additionally, to further optimize model performance, the DualConv module is designed by cleverly combining 3×3 group convolution and 1×1 pointwise convolution. This design solves the issue of poor inter-channel communication while effectively preserving critical information from the original input feature map. As a result, it enhances detection accuracy while achieving model lightweighting, thus improving processing speed and efficiency. The experimental results show that, on the sintered NdFeB dataset, the model achieves an improvement of 7.5% in mAP@0.5 and 2.5% in mAP@0.5:0.95 compared to the baseline model. With a model size of 52.3 MB and 126.3 GFLOPs, it maintains the lightweight parameters of the baseline model while significantly enhancing detection performance.

articleTitle: Medical CT Image Super-resolution Algorithm based on GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Computed Tomography (CT) images are essential for visualizing the internal structures of the human body and are widely applied in the diagnosis of various diseases. However, during the processes of generating, storing, and transmitting medical CT images, the clarity of these images can be degraded by non-human factors, resulting in issues such as reduced resolution and blurred texture details, thereby compromising image fidelity. In this study, we present an approach utilizing Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). that incorporates a grayscale value loss as an additional constraint while maintaining the original loss function constraints. We conduct experiments for 4x super-resolution reconstruction. To evaluate the reconstruction performance, we compare the Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) of the reconstructed images. The experimental results demonstrate ,which the proposed method exhibits promising performance in both quantitative metrics and visual quality.

articleTitle: Points and Patches in Textures by Exploring in Monocular Depth Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Rich texture information is sometimes not good for deep learning, and can introduce unwanted noise information, especially for monocular depth learning. In order to solve the phenomenon of ‘messy textures’ caused by rich texture in monocular depth estimation, this paper exploits the property of intra-patch disparity consistency to reconstruct the image to mitigate this phenomenon. The joint training method using patch matching and single-point matching is verified on Cityscapes and KITTI Engie Split datasets to achieve better results.

articleTitle: Research on Dry Beach Extraction and Safety Parameter Calculation of Tailing Pond based on UAV Point Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: This study focuses on using UAV photogrammetry and point cloud data processing to extract and calculate key safety parameters for the dry beach of tailings ponds. UAV technology, known for its low cost, operational simplicity, and comprehensive data coverage, is particularly useful for surveying large and complex terrains. The research was conducted at the Baizhangzi Gold Mine in Liaoning, China, where UAVs were employed to capture high-resolution point cloud data of the tailings pond.Key techniques used include slope threshold filtering, Delaunay triangulation, and the alpha-shape method to extract features such as the dry beach boundary and crest points. These features are crucial for safety monitoring as they allow the calculation of parameters like slope gradient, beach length, and dam freeboard. The study emphasizes the precision of 3D point cloud data compared to 2D images, offering more accurate and reliable results for monitoring tailings dam safety. The results showed that the calculated parameters closely matched real-world measurements, with errors below 1%. This demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed methods in ensuring the safety and stability of tailings ponds through regular monitoring. The research provides a scientific basis for future safety assessments and risk management in mining operations.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale and Multi-Modal Contrastive Learning for Hyperspectral and LiDAR Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: The combination of hyperspectral imagery (HSI) and light detection and ranging (LiDAR) data enables the simultaneous exploitation of rich spectral and elevation information and has become a hot research topic in land-cover classification. However, the reliance on large datasets with costly manual annotations presents a significant challenge to the scalability of models. To address the issues of labeled data scarcity and model generalization, we propose a dual-branch multi-scale contrastive learning (DMCL) framework for the joint classification of HSI and LiDAR data. The model training process consists of self-supervised pre-training and supervised fine-tuning. During the pre-training phase, intra-modal and inter-modal contrastive tasks are exploited to learn multi-modal invariant features and capture the correlations between different modalities. In the fine-tuning stage, a simple yet effective fusion module is introduced to obtain more effective representations and adapt the model for the joint classification task. Experimental results show that, compared with other methods, the DMCL framework achieves the highest overall accuracy of 88.68%, 98.09%, and 76.25% on the Houston 2013, Trento, and MUUFL datasets, respectively.

articleTitle: A Novel Intelligent Classifier Based on Instantiated Weighted One-dependence Estimators
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Bayesian network classifiers (BNCs) are learned from data using various independence assumptions that reduce topology complexity and improve generalization, while in practice these assumptions are often described by probability-theoretic metrics. As a state-of-the-art BNC, averaged one-dependence estimators (AODE) exhibit excellent training efficiency and superior classification performance because they encompass 1-dependence relationships fully. However, the dependence relationships are complex. In this paper, by integrating Bayesian inference with independence analysis, we propose the instantiated weighted AODE (IWAODE) that can measure the dependency relationship between specific attribute values, and then derive the decomposition of the local log-likelihood for fine-tuning the weights of the committee members in AODE. Extensive evaluations were conducted on 12 datasets. Our IWAODE outperforms five leading-edge benchmarks regarding zero-to-one loss, as demonstrated by the findings.

articleTitle: Research on Gastritis Endoscopic Images Classification Based on SE-RepLKNet
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Autoimmune gastritis (AIG) is an atrophic gastritis caused by abnormal autoimmune function. Recent studies indicate an increasing prevalence of AIG in China. In advanced stages, AIG can progress to neuroendocrine tumors and gastric adenocarcinoma, posing a life-threatening risk to patients. However, due to the insufficient clinical awareness and nonspecific clinical manifestations of the disease, AIG has a low diagnostic rate and is frequently misdiagnosed as type B gastritis caused by Helicobacter pylori infection, which leads to delayed diagnosis. Gastroscopy serves as a critical tool for diagnosing AIG based on distinct gastroscopic features of AIG and type B gastritis. This study proposes a gastritis classification and diagnostic method based on gastroscopic images using a deep learning model, RepLKNet, with large-kernel convolution. Additionally, a channel attention mechanism, the SE module, is integrated to enhance the model's feature extraction capability. Considering the scarcity of publicly available medical image datasets for pretraining, a two-stage pretraining strategy is adopted to incrementally train the model for extracting hierarchical features. Experimental results demonstrate a classification accuracy of 89.6% on gastroscopic images. This system provides clinicians with more accurate classification suggestions for two frequently misdiagnosed types of gastritis, offering crucial information for subsequent treatment and examination.

articleTitle: Research on River Floating Objects Detection Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: The environmental issues have become increasingly prominent, and water environments have remained a major societal concern. Surface pollutants in rivers are one of the key factors damaging water environments. Given the large number and wide distribution of rivers, manual river inspections and the collection of floating objects are time-consuming and labor-intensive. In this study, a river surface floating objects detection method based on deep learning is proposed. To address the noise issues caused by interferences in natural scenes, an image preprocessing method based on median filtering and Laplace operator is studied. In order to select the most suitable deep learning algorithm, this work compares the YOLOv5, Faster-RCNN, and SSD algorithms. After comparative analysis, an optimized YOLOv5 model is proposed for detecting floating objects on river surfaces. Finally, a visualization platform is developed based on PyQt5, enabling real-time monitoring and display of floating objects in river surveillance videos. Experimental results demonstrate that this method can effectively detect floating objects on river surfaces, with recall rate of 0.741 for artificial trash, mAP@0.5 of 0.798, and mAP@0.5:0.95 of 0.704. This system achieves real-time surface floating objects monitoring in rivers and open channels, providing crucial information for the protection and management of water environments.

articleTitle: Semantic Segmentation Method for Drivable Areas under Unstructured Road
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: To improve the ability of autonomous vehicles to recognize drivable areas on park roads, this study puts foward a semantic segmentation approach based on the STDC (Short-Term Dense Connection) network. On this foundation of the STDC network, a deep convolutional neural network with an encoder-decoder structure is designed, and a double-chain cascaded feature fusion module (DCFFM) is introduced. Additionally, the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) is incorporated to dynamically adjust channel and spatial attention, thereby reinforcing the model s capacity to discern crucial features. A dataset suitable for drivable area segmentation in park environments was collected and used for training and validation. The experimental outcomes demonstrate that the algorithm attained a mIoU of 98.41% on the self-built dataset, representing a 2.73 percentage point improvement over the STDC network. Furthermore, the mIoU on public datasets exhibited a 2.55 percentage point enhancement in comparison to that of the STDC network.

articleTitle: YOLO-CDP: An Improved Algorithm for Bearing Surface Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: To address the challenges of low detection accuracy for tiny defects and the issue of large model sizes in bearing surface defect detection, we present YOLO-CDP, a lightweight detection algorithm developed on the foundation of YOLOv8n. First, we design the C2f_DSConv module to enable the model to sense defects of different scales and shapes, and improve the accuracy of defect identification and localization. Second, we use the feature-based content-aware reassembly upsampling operator CARAFE in the neck, helping the model capture richer contextual information and enhancing its feature representation capacity. Finally, we add a new small object detection layer for detecting small-size defects on the bearing surface. Experimental results indicate that YOLO-CDP achieves a mAP of 92.4%, an increase of 3.8% over the original algorithm. The model has only 3.4M parameters, ensuring lightweight efficiency while enhancing detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Life Control Based on Limited Incremental learning and WE-OSELM
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: This paper coordinates the differences between the connotations of remaining life control and reference life control, and adopts a data-driven life prediction method to carry out real-time differential life prediction under unknown failure mechanism conditions. Based on the research of WE-OSELM algorithm, this paper integrates the design of multi-step prediction method and proposes a remaining life prediction method and prediction model based on finite incremental learning and WE-OSELM. Firstly, in view of the fact that the number of hidden layer nodes affects the performance of the prediction algorithm, the finite incremental learning method is used to quickly screen the optimal number of hidden layer nodes within a limited range, and the IPW-OSELM algorithm training is quickly completed by integrating historical degradation data and online time series data. Then, the error data in the training process of the IPW-OSELM algorithm is used to train the error compensation algorithm. Finally, the failure threshold and multi-step prediction results are combined to determine the remaining life of the prediction object. Simulation comparison shows that the algorithm in this paper not only has a high conservative remaining life prediction ability, but also has the ability to accurately predict to a certain extent, and the results are highly credible.

articleTitle: Design of End Effector for Acupuncture Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: At present, the training period of acupuncturists is long, the number is small, and the acupuncture treatment lacks objectivity and standard. In order to reduce the pressure on acupuncturists and improve the objectivity and standard of acupuncture treatment, the research on acupuncture and moxibustion robots is urgent. Aiming at the problem of simulating traditional Chinese acupuncture techniques in the process of acupuncture robot, according to the treatment requirements of scalp acupuncture, a kind of acupuncture end effector based on the six degrees of freedom robot arm was proposed. The actuator uses the six degrees of freedom of the mechanical arm to realize twirling action and simplify the actuator structure, and uses the stepping motor lead screw and stepping motor to realize needle insertion in acupuncture and clamping action, simulates the acupuncturist's treatment techniques, and designs the end effector control system based on PLC according to the treatment requirements of scalp acupuncture. Through simulation and experimental validation, the end effector developed in this research has demonstrated stable performance and accurate needle insertion for acupuncture applications. This achievement establishes a solid foundation for further advancements in the research and development of acupuncture and moxibustion robotics.

articleTitle: Anti-Lost Smart Buttons and Supervision Platform for the Elderly and Children Using Electronic Fences
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: The prevalence of elderly individuals and children becoming lost is becoming increasingly acute. To address this pressing societal issue, we have developed an Anti-Lost Smart Button and Supervision Platform specifically designed for these vulnerable demographics, employing electronic fencing technology. This system integrates a smart button with a corresponding supervision platform, utilizing data obtained from the Beidou satellite navigation module, a 5G communication module, and various sensors embedded within the smart button to facilitate data transmission.

articleTitle: Research on a Deep Learning-Based Congestion Detection and Optimization Method for Army Tactical Airspace
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: To address the congestion issue in tactical airspace management, this paper proposes a deep learning-based method for airspace congestion detection and traffic optimization. The method first utilizes a three-dimension Convolutional Neural Network (3D CNN) to construct a congestion detection model, enabling real-time prediction of congestion conditions within the tactical airspace. Subsequently, Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is applied to automatically regulate airspace traffic, reducing the risk of airspace conflicts. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms traditional approaches in both congestion detection accuracy and traffic regulation effectiveness, providing an efficient solution for airspace management.

articleTitle: A Conflicting Evidence Fusion Method Based on a Greedy Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: To address the issue of the conventional D-S combination rule not effectively dealing with highly conflicting evidence fusion, a conflicting evidence fusion algorithm utilizing a greedy strategy is proposed. First, by adopting a greedy strategy, the effective evidence distance is defined based on Jousselme’s evidence distance, followed by the definition of strongly and weakly correlated evidence. The average value of the effective evidence distance is calculated, and based on this the evidence is classified. Finally, weights are calculated individually for the classified evidence. Weights are then reassigned to the two types of evidence, and the corrected evidence is fused to obtain the final fusion result. Numerical examples are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper in addressing the limitations of the conventional D-S combination rule for fusing highly conflicting evidence.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral and Multispectral image Fusion based on diffusion model and MergeCNN
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: In recent years, diffusion models have attracted attention for Hyperspectral and Multi-spectral image fusion or Pansharping. However, a little noise often remains in the images generated by diffusion models, which affects the final quality. To mitigate this issue, we propose a diffusion model-based method for hyperspectral and multispectral image fusion. We introduce the MergeCNN module, which excels in local feature extraction and feature representation through deep convolution, and has a significant advantage in noise suppression.The MergeCNN module combined with the diffusion model further optimises the details of the image and improves the quality of the image. Experimental results on two public datasets show that DIFF-Merge exhibits advanced performance compared to existing commonly used methods.

articleTitle: SPM-MIM: A super-pixel based masked image modeling method for multitemporal remote sensing land cover classification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a super-pixel based multitemporal masked image modeling (SPM-MIM) method for multitemporal remote sensing land cover classification. Compared with the previous self-supervised masked image modeling methods, SPM-MIM masks and reconstructs images based on super-pixels, effectively avoiding the problem that tiny remote sensing scenes are completely covered, while better retaining the structural information of remote sensing scenes, so that the model can be trained with stronger feature extraction capabilities. In order to better combine multi-temporal information to achieve land cover classification, we propose a cross-temporal information complementary module (CTICM). CTICM interacts with shallow multi-temporal features in spatial dimension to promote cross-phase information complementarity in local scenes, and interacts with deep multi-temporal features in channel dimension to promote cross-phase information complementarity in global scenes. Experimental results on remote sensing images of Gaofen-1 Harbin area and Gaofen2 Dalian Lushun area show that our proposed SPM-MIM method has excellent land cover classification capability.

articleTitle: Research on Pump Condition Prediction Based on Ensemble Learning Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Failures in water pumps can lead to shutdowns, production disruptions, and resource wastage, particularly in areas such as industrial production, water supply, and flood control, where the impact is significant and the losses immeasurable. Therefore, monitoring and early warning to enhance the operational efficiency and stability of water pumps is crucial. Based on research into deep learning algorithms, this paper proposes and implements a pump condition prediction model using an ensemble learning strategy. By constructing three different models: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and Deep Neural Network (DNN), the states of the water pump within different time windows are predicted respectively. Among them, the LSTM model performs better, achieving an accuracy rate of 98.3%. Finally, an ensemble learning strategy based on voting is employed to integrate the prediction results from the LSTM, CNN, and DNN models, achieving an accuracy rate of 98.5%. This approach improves the overall prediction performance.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Job Shop Scheduling Solutions: A MILP Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Effective job shop scheduling is crucial for optimizing productivity in tobacco manufacturing, where dynamic factors such as worker capabilities significantly impact efficiency. This study addresses the limitations of traditional scheduling models by integrating worker learning and forgetting effects into the job shop scheduling process. The primary objective is to enhance production efficiency by minimizing makespan and balancing workloads among machines and workers. We propose a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) framework, solved using an improved memetic algorithm (IMA) that leverages adaptive neighborhood search strategies. Comparative experiments with simulated annealing (SA) and particle swarm optimization (PSO) demonstrate that the IMA achieves superior performance across multiple scenarios, particularly in minimizing makespan and energy consumption. The results show that accounting for worker learning and forgetting effects leads to more accurate predictions of production capacity and better utilization of human resources, ultimately enhancing overall productivity. This study offers a comprehensive approach to integrating human factors into industrial scheduling, providing valuable insights for both academia and industry practitioners.

articleTitle: Multi-Source Face Relighting: Pre-fusion and Post-fusion Approaches for Improved Lighting Consistency and Detail Preservation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: Multi-source face relighting is a key challenge in computer vision due to its applications in virtual reality, face recognition, and image editing, yet existing methods struggle with lighting consistency, shadow modeling, and detail preservation under complex multi-light-source conditions. This paper introduces two approaches, pre-fusion and post-fusion, to address these challenges by extending single-light-source relighting methods to multi-source scenarios. The pre-fusion approach unifies multiple light source parameters before relighting, improving lighting consistency and shadow modeling, while the post-fusion approach fuses individual relit images at the pixel level, preserving fine details with flexible control. Evaluations on a custom dataset and the FFHQ dataset show that pre-fusion outperforms post-fusion in terms of MSE, PSNR, and DSSIM. Experimental results confirm that pre-fusion effectively enhances lighting consistency and preserves details, offering a practical solution for real-world multi-source face relighting.

articleTitle: A Conflicting Evidence Fusion Method Based on Game Theory Combination Weighting
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: This essay introduces a new approach to address the challenges of applying Dempster-Shafer evidence theory to tackling high-conflict evidence. We first employed Jousselme’s distance and compatibility coefficients to measure confidence and support, then converted these values into vectors. Next, we applied game theory to convert the vectors into a system of linear equations,from which we obtained a corresponding combination of weight coefficients that we used to modify the initial evidence. Finally, we applied the Dempster-Shafer combination rule to achieve evidence fusion. A case analysis shows that our proposed method provides more sensible fusion results for high-conflict evidence.

articleTitle: The Application of Random Neural Networks in Fiber Optic Vibration Signal Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Computer, Vision and Intelligent Technology (ICCVIT)
abstract: With the prosperity of information technology, fiber optic sensing technology is popularly applied in scenarios such as disturbance detection and security issues. In order to enhance the recognition effect of detection systems on fiber optic vibration signals, a signal detection method grounded on random neural networks is proposed.
